description: This Python source file defines classes and methods for transforming and routing requests and responses between OpenAI's chat completion API and Triton's /generate and /infer endpoints. It includes configuration classes, request/response transformation logic, and a response iterator for streaming responses, specifically tailored for Triton models within a larger language model framework.

classes.name: TritonConfig
classes.description: Base configuration class for Triton endpoints, handling routing, environment validation, parameter mapping, and response transformation based on endpoint type.

classes.name: TritonGenerateConfig
classes.description: Handles request and response transformation for Triton's /generate endpoint, including JSON response parsing.

classes.name: TritonInferConfig
classes.description: Handles request and response transformation for Triton's /infer endpoint, including input preparation and output parsing.

classes.name: TritonResponseIterator
classes.description: Iterates over streaming responses from Triton, parsing chunks into a standardized format.

methods.name: get_error_class
methods.description: Returns a TritonError exception with provided message, status, and headers.

methods.name: validate_environment
methods.description: Validates or sets environment headers for requests.

methods.name: get_supported_openai_params
methods.description: Returns list of supported OpenAI parameters.

methods.name: map_openai_params
methods.description: Maps OpenAI parameters to optional parameters for Triton.

methods.name: get_complete_url
methods.description: Constructs the full URL for Triton API based on base URL, model, and stream type.

methods.name: transform_response
methods.description: Transforms raw HTTP response into a ModelResponse object, delegating to specific endpoint classes.

methods.name: transform_request
methods.description: Prepares request payload for Triton /generate or /infer endpoints.

methods.name: _get_triton_llm_type
methods.description: Determines whether the API base URL indicates a 'generate' or 'infer' endpoint.

methods.name: get_model_response_iterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator for streaming responses.

methods.name: chunk_parser
methods.description: Parses a chunk of streaming data into a standardized format.
